privileged_info_for_vlm: For the NREL 5MW turbine, the Power Coefficient (Cp) curve typically crosses zero (Runaway TSR) at a TSR between 11.0 and 16.0 for 0° pitch. For 5° pitch, the aerodynamic braking effect shifts this point to a lower TSR, typically between 7.0 and 12.0. The simulation must use a step of 0.5 as specified.
